profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Java | Spring Boot | React
profile.summary:
My journey into tech as a software developer has been a rollercoaster, to say the least, but I didn’t always want to be a developer, I wanted to be a graphic designer. I attended a community college and received my associates in graphic design and soon after I attended the SUNY College of Brockport, where I majored in graphic design. I was really sold on becoming a graphic designer, I had done numerous internships and was still unable to land a job. One thing I noticed was that most graphic design jobs wanted you to know some form of coding. It was then I attended a boot camp for web development, this is where I found my passion. I didn’t expect to enjoy coding, but I learned it still allowed me to be creative, innovative and challenged my problem-solving skills. I realized software engineering was the right field for me.

Fast forward to today and I still enjoy coding. Though I enjoy front-end development more, I have found a real appreciation for coding on the backend. Yes I know, backend developers don’t get as much credit as they should. Currently employed as a software engineer at Infosys and working on a project that allows me to utilize and improve my skills.

I’m familiar with numerous programming languages including Java, Spring Boot, HTML, CSS, Angular, and React, but I’m always adding and learning new skill sets. 

If you want to know more about me, send me a message or reach out to me at erikajtech@gmail.com.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
● The Atlas Program is an extension of Eleven Fifty Academy, designed to give postgraduates real-world experience working within an agile team environment while continuing to develop their skills and education.
● I worked as a Frontend Developer for a polling application created for a fictitious internet polling company called "Shi-Tech". The application stack is built using React, HTML, and CSS. The frontend team utilizes a restful API, developed by a backend team using a C# stack connected to a SQL database and deployed using AWS. 
● I assisted in developing a functional and appealing web- and mobile-based application similar to the UX/UI team's prototype created in Figma, met with backend developers to solve database and API structure, collaborated with UX/UI to assess and discuss accessibility issues, and contributed to the team.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Communication and +11 skills
